name: Army Pay
text: The army wants more pay.

name: Bad Harvest
text: Bad harvest. Less food.

name: Price List
text: The emperor sets a price list.

name: Silver Mountain
text: We found a silver mountain!

name: Silver Ships
text: Ships bring silver to Asia.

name: The King's Loans
text: The king cannot pay his debts.

name: One Kind of Coin
text: All coins are now one kind.

name: Paper Money
text: Paper money! It is light and easy.

name: War Costs
text: We need money for war.

name: Silver Taxes
text: Pay all taxes in silver now.

name: Silver Comes
text: Silver comes from across the sea.

name: Silver Leaves
text: Silver leaves to buy opium.

name: Silver Vase
text: A silver vase is our big money.

name: New Coins
text: New coins for everyone!

name: Hidden Coins
text: People hide coins. Coins are hard to find.

name: War Money
text: We print paper money for the war.

name: Banks Close
text: Banks close. People are scared.

name: Oil Shock
text: Oil stops coming!

name: Good Harvest
text: Lots of food this year!

name: Storm
text: A big storm hit the farms.

name: New Invention
text: Someone made a new tool!

name: Trade Fair
text: Traders come from far away.

name: Rumor
text: People say your coins are fake.

name: War!
text: An enemy attacks! We must fight.

name: War Nearby
text: Two lands near you are at war.

name: Peace at Last
text: The war is over. People are happy.

name: Quiet Year
text: Nothing big happened.
